summary: Qt/OpenCascade CAD viewer with a documented batch conversion CLI for CAD and mesh formats. It targets interchange and inspection of engineering geometry, rather than scene authoring or rendering.
use_when: Batch convert engineering CAD and mesh formats through a documented CLI
Inspect CAD files with a desktop viewer before converting them
avoid_when: Use Blender for scene authoring, materials and creative rendering
Use a dedicated mesh converter when only a simple format conversion is required

assessment.rationale: Official project describes CAD viewing/conversion and batch CLI; repository shows current development and MIT licensing. macOS build route and headless operation should be confirmed before promotion.
